sourcePolicy: AA explicit values and custom clauses remain authoritative. Direct2023Wiki snapshots and pinned Valve KV supply compatible nonnumeric behavior; modern redesigns are excluded. Named result tests do not certify unresolved combinations.

validation.meaning: Three skills have complete reviewed clauses within the declared hero/summon arena surface; Bloodrage and Brain Sap retain precise unresolved source requirements. This is five of230 skills, not full-catalog acceptance.

scope: Hero/summon arena: couriers, buildings and item purchases such as Skull Basher are absent. Native hero-identity restrictions on Basher are not generalized into a prohibition on AA skill combinations.

sources.observation: Four successful melee/ranged contacts;50/100/200 physical bonus and1/1.1/1.3 stun; creep double. Super+150 and creep execution; Gaben reduces required contacts by one. The passive has no mana cost or cast cooldown.
